veranderings.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
veranderings.rede: Kernkrag names the power produced; the heat comes from nuclear energy, which also matches the lesson's energie-not-krag rule (the station name Kernkragstasie stays).

veranderings.blok: Die pad van die stasie af na 'n huis
veranderings.voor: loop die elektrisiteit in groot dik drade weg
veranderings.na: loop die elektrisiteit deur groot, dik drade weg
veranderings.rede: Electricity runs 'deur' wires, as elsewhere in the lesson, and two equal adjectives take a comma under the AWS.

veranderings.voor: By jou lampie het ook twee drade geloop
veranderings.na: By jou lampie het daar ook twee drade geloop
veranderings.rede: An indefinite subject after a fronted adverbial reads more naturally with existential 'daar', as the lesson does elsewhere.

veranderings.na: net soos jou lampie se stroombaan
veranderings.rede: The word stroombaan has not appeared in the text before, so 'daardie' has no clear antecedent; tie it to the lamp just mentioned.
A lamp or kettle does not 'stand still'; 'werk nie' says the same thing naturally for every appliance.

veranderings.voor: ver van hier af in 'n bron gelê
veranderings.rede: 'Hier' has no clear point of reference in the sentence; 'ver weg' keeps the meaning without it.
